name: Storm Front
body:
School conjuration (creation) [electricity]; Level druid 4, magus 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, unchained summoner 4, witch 4

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft. level)

Effect fog spreads in 20-ft. radius

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw Reflex half, see text; Spell Resistance no

This spell functions as fog cloud, except the duration is shorter and the cloud is suffused with charged electricity. Any creature entering or beginning their turn within the cloud takes 1d4 points of electricity damage +1 per caster level (maximum +15).
